cards.observation_text: The diet record excludes specialization in sparse Saharan grasses and shrubs.

cards.observation_text: The native range extends beyond the coastal dunes of Namaqualand.
cards.inference_text: A species confined to that dune belt cannot explain this range.
cards.bonus_fact_text: Remaining populations occur in fragmented habitats across South and Southeast Asia.
hints: The map footprint spans far more than one coastal dune belt.
